description: LEAP-2025: Effects of Relative Density and Static Shear Stress on Cyclic Response of Ottawa F65 Sand at Three Different Densities is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Majid Manzari, George Washington University (gwu.edu). A series of cyclic direct simple shear tests are conducted to investigate the effect of static shear stress on stress-strain-strength behavior of Ottawa F65 sand at three distinct relative densities (50%, 60%, and 90%). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Cyclic Direct Simple Shear Test, Liquefaction, Relative Density, Sand, Static Shear Stress, Stress-Strain Response. Published 2025-07-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
